desc:
✅ Welcome to Find The Doge Heads 2! This game is a classic badge hunt with over 800 badges to collect, all with a different objective. Will you be one of the few overachievers and collect every badge?

🔔 If you want to get notified for updates of the game, or just want Group Doge, join the official fan group here:
https://www.roblox.com/groups/4132464

❌ Expect to see free models and poor builds in some of the older areas. We are actively working to revamp most areas to remove anything that wasn't built by us and to improve the game's quality overall.

⭐ Big thanks to everyone that contributed to this game, I could not have done it without you!
